title.zh-TW: 美公布海外 AI 晶片存取新規，關注出口許可範圍
title.en: US announces rules on overseas access to advanced AI chips

summary.zh-TW: 中央社引述路透報導，美國商務部公布規定，防止中國企業透過第三國資料中心遠端使用先進 AI 晶片，部分國家企業取得高階晶片須申請許可。適用細節應依官方規則核對。
summary.en: CNA, citing Reuters, reports US rules addressing Chinese access to advanced AI chips through third-country data centers, with licensing requirements for certain destinations. Specific applicability requires checking the official rules.

impact.zh-TW: 追蹤許可、客戶部署與交付時程；新規不等於所有海外訂單取消。
impact.en: Track licensing and deployment schedules; the announcement does not establish cancellation of all overseas orders.

title.zh-TW: 台股11/16跌6.03%，AI 供應鏈風險重新定價
title.en: Taiwan stocks fell 6.03% on November 16 amid AI repricing

summary.zh-TW: 中央社報導，11/16 加權指數收41040.08點，下跌2635.04點、跌幅6.03%。台積電收2215元、台達電收1120元。這些是已完成交易日收盤，不是11/17即時報價。
summary.en: CNA reports the November 16 TAIEX close at 41,040.08, down 2,635.04 points or 6.03%. TSMC closed at NT$2,215 and Delta at NT$1,120. These are completed-session closes, not live November 17 quotes.

impact.zh-TW: 區分股價波動與企業基本面，不能由單日下跌推定隔日必反彈。
impact.en: Separate price volatility from fundamentals; a one-day decline does not establish a next-day rebound.

title.zh-TW: Fed 主席談 AI 經濟機會與風險，並非政策決議
title.en: Fed chair outlines AI opportunities and risks, not a policy decision

summary.zh-TW: 路透報導，Warsh 討論 AI 對生產力與就業的不同情境；這不是確定的經濟預測或新利率決議。
summary.en: Reuters reports Warsh discussed alternative AI scenarios for productivity and employment, not a settled economic forecast or a new rate decision.

impact.zh-TW: 檢視企業實際回報，不將 AI 願景視為獲利。
impact.en: Assess realized business returns rather than treating AI ambitions as earnings.

title.zh-TW: 中國10月工業與零售增速放緩，內需復甦仍待觀察
title.en: China October production and retail data point to softer demand

summary.zh-TW: 路透引述官方數據，10月工業產出年增4.8%、零售年增0.4%，皆低於調查預期；年增不代表月增。
summary.en: Reuters cites official October industrial-output growth of 4.8% and retail growth of 0.4%, both below poll forecasts. These are year-on-year rates.

impact.zh-TW: 分別檢查消費與投資需求，勿直接套用個別台廠。
impact.en: Assess consumption and investment separately; aggregate figures do not determine individual Taiwanese company results.

title.zh-TW: 台灣科技白皮書草案納入主權 AI，實施與採購仍待後續
title.en: Taiwan science-policy draft includes sovereign AI; execution remains ahead

summary.zh-TW: 中央社報導，國科會提出2027至2030年科學技術白皮書草案，涵蓋半導體、主權 AI、太空等九項議題。草案不等於預算或個別企業訂單已核定。
summary.en: CNA reports a draft 2027–2030 science and technology white paper covering nine themes, including semiconductors, sovereign AI and space. A draft does not establish approved budgets or company orders.

impact.zh-TW: 追蹤正式政策、預算與採購進度，避免先把政策方向換算成公司收入。
impact.en: Track adopted policy, budgets and procurement before translating policy direction into company revenue.

reason.zh-TW: 報導直接提及11/16股價；觀察後續公司揭露與客戶需求，將市場情緒和營運分開。
reason.en: The report names TSMC in the November 16 session. Watch company disclosures and customer demand separately from market sentiment.

risk.zh-TW: 單日跌幅不代表估值已便宜，客戶投資與政策變化仍有不確定性。
risk.en: A one-day decline does not establish cheap valuation; customer spending and policy remain uncertain.

reason.zh-TW: 以伺服器產業觀察出口許可與主權 AI 部署後續；報導未公告廣達新增訂單。
reason.en: Use the server business to monitor licensing and sovereign-AI deployment. The stories announce no new Quanta orders.

risk.zh-TW: 政策草案尚待實施；許可、零組件與客戶建置時程可能影響交付。
risk.en: Draft policy still needs execution; licensing, components and customer schedules can affect delivery.

reason.zh-TW: 報導直接提及11/16收盤；以電源與自動化業務觀察實際需求，避免把股價波動當成訂單訊號。
reason.en: The report names Delta’s November 16 close. Monitor demand in power and automation without treating price moves as order signals.

risk.zh-TW: 專案時程、需求與匯率仍可能波動，跌停不構成未來反彈保證。
risk.en: Project timing, demand and currencies remain variable; a limit-down close does not guarantee a rebound.

reason.zh-TW: 以 PC 品牌觀察消費需求與庫存，應再對照公司揭露；中國零售總量不是華碩營收。
reason.en: Monitor consumer demand and inventories against company disclosures. China’s aggregate retail figures are not ASUS revenue.

risk.zh-TW: 產品組合、區域銷售與成本不同，單月總體數據不足推估公司獲利。
risk.en: Product mix, regional sales and costs differ; one month of macro data cannot establish company earnings.

reason.zh-TW: 以金融類股觀察生產力與就業情境如何影響利率及信用需求；Fed 談話未揭露兆豐業績。
reason.en: Use the financial sector to monitor how productivity and employment scenarios may affect rates and credit demand. The remarks disclose no Mega results.

risk.zh-TW: AI 的總體影響仍不確定，利差、信用成本與匯率可能朝不同方向變化。
risk.en: AI’s macro effects remain uncertain; margins, credit costs and currencies can move in different directions.
